question.text: Under what structure must distribution/placement fees be paid to AIF distributors?

answer.text: Equal trail basis, paid only from the management fee received by the Manager

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates an equal trail-basis structure — no upfront distribution/placement fee, and the fee is payable only out of the Manager's management fee receipts. The Trap: Any upfront structure is prohibited. Performance-linked distributor payouts are not the prescribed model. Cross-Exam Context: Contrasts with MF distributor models (V-A) where trail is permitted but upfront has been separately addressed.
